replayBase.note: Fix B (Auditor): the model a retrain restores, starts from, scores as live and replays the training manifest of, with its manifest (= replay.manifestSha256) and core-free proof pins. Pinned here, separate from Results models/lm/latest.json: promoting a retrained model never changes the replay chain. live.version must equal replayBase.version (lm-retrain-live.sh refuses otherwise).

promoted.note: Auditor (after promotion, Results 0d86e8c): the model a retrain candidate must beat before any next promotion. setcBpb is the promoted model's set C v2 bits/byte from its own run record (runs/lm-retrain/<runId>/record.json setcV2.bitsPerByte.candidate, record pinned by recordSha256), never the replay base's. The gate is bpb_gate.py with the same eval.minBpbGain margin: candidate <= setcBpb - minBpbGain (1.5282 - 0.005 = 1.5232), in addition to the in-run margin over replayBase. lm-retrain-promoted.sh verifies the record and that Results models/lm/latest.json names this version, in corpus-gate before any training and again right before the gate; any mismatch refuses. Training, restoring and replay stay on replayBase. Re-pin this entry (version, runId, recordSha256, setcBpb) in the same reviewed change as any later promotion.

finetune.forgettingFix: run 40375535718 (set C v2 bpb 1.6506 -> 2.0670): 18 distinct files with 85% duplicated lines, 1200 steps = ~25 passes, split by (commit, path, function) so 92% of heldout lines were in train and all 16 val windows sat in one doc. Now: one version per (repo, path, function), split by file path, replayFrac of every batch from the live model's pretrain train split, validation on valWindows pretrain-heldout docs (one window per doc), 300 steps.

sweep.select: lowest validation loss on the replay corpus's pretrain-heldout windows (finetune.valWindows docs; never set C v2, the judge items or the fine-tune corpus); ties: earlier step, then first arm

pretrain.note: Continued pretraining (Builder + Auditor, 2026-10-27): every batch row from the live model's own full pretrain train split (replay.pretrainTrainMaxBytes; ftRows must be 0), fresh AdamW from the live weights (--init-from; the live model has no optimizer state), validation on the same pretrain-heldout windows as finetune. 1200 x 16 x 512 = ~9.8M tokens, ~0.44 of an epoch of the ~22.4M-token split, so no doc repeats. The fine-tune corpus is still built, proven core-free and memchecked (strict), but contributes no training rows.

budget.rule: pretrain mode only: train.py --deadline = job start (JOB_START, set by the job's Job clock step) + <role>JobSeconds (the job's timeout-minutes x 60) - reserve; it also stops before a step (or eval) that would not finish before it. On a time cut the run ends cleanly at the last validation-selected step (sweep: summary bestStep, the validation-selected step reached; candidate: a cut before the selected step fails the gate as selected_step_not_reached) and the record is still written. finalReserveSeconds 5700 = eval.scoringReserveSeconds (1200, gate and landing) + 4500 for scoring live and candidate (set C ~1900 s each, plus the judge set), so the candidate stops by JOB_START + 15300 s (after run 40624227227).

eval.minBpbGainRule: candidate set C v2 bits/byte <= live - minBpbGain (decimal arithmetic; bpb_gate.py), judged on the candidate retrained to the validation-selected step; set C is the final gate only
eval.scoringDeadlineRule: both modes: set C and judge scoring in finetune-eval-land must end by JOB_START + pretrain.budget.finalJobSeconds (the job timeout) - scoringReserveSeconds (time kept for the gate and the record landing); a scoring command still running at that deadline is killed and its partial output removed, scoring stops, the gate lands a no-candidate record (failed: scoring_deadline) and the job ends red
